_note: Interest on a loan for a house: "An assessee, being an individual not eligible to claim deduction under section 130, shall be allowed a deduction of interest payable on loan taken by him from any financial institution for the purpose of acquisition of a residential house property, subject to a maximum limit of ₹150000" (s.131(1), p.166); "(a) the loan has been sanctioned … during the period beginning on the 1st April, 2019 and ending on the 31st March, 2022; (b) the stamp duty value of residential house property does not exceed forty-five lakh rupees; and (c) the assessee does not own any residential house property on the date of sanction of loan" (s.131(2)). ChapterEightNode tries DED-HOUSE-LOAN-EARLIER first. The same interest is not deductible under any other provision for the same or any other tax year (s.131(3)) — house-property interest under s.22(1)(b) must leave it out (W-078). rulebook DED-80EEA-001, DED-80EX-001. Old regime only (s.202(2)(a)(xii), p.227). TY 2026-27 only; the 1961 counterpart, s.80EEA, is unread (W-075d). D-139.
